note: Avatar maker settings. Models are swappable here: set `version` for a community model, leave it null for an official one.

generate.prompt: Replace the mannequin in the first image with the person from the other photos. Keep the first image exactly as it is: same camera angle (looking down from above at about 33 degrees), same framing, same body direction, same position and size in the frame, same plain flat light gray background, same soft shadow under the feet. The person stands in the mannequin's exact pose and facing direction, full body, feet in the same place. Keep the person's real face, hair, skin, build and outfit from their photos. Photorealistic. Nothing else in the image: no other people, no grid, no props, no text.
generate.note: Template swap, same method that worked in DressUp: the placeholder mannequin on a plain background fixes pose, angle and framing; the background stays plain so the cutout is clean.

normalize.note: Brief 02c said band 0.04 / lift 0.03. Measured on the hand-placed presets the cross sits 4 to 9% above the lowest pixel (median 7.5%): the near foot's toe is always lowest at this camera, and a 4% band only sees that one shoe. Run `npx tsx scripts/normalize-avatar.ts --check-presets` after changing these.
